summary.en: Model fixed choices with enums and transparent data values with records.
summary.bn: নির্দিষ্ট কয়েকটি অপশনের জন্য এনাম, আর ডেটা মান রাখার জন্য রেকর্ড ব্যবহার করো।

notes: Enums arrived in Java 5, switch expressions in Java 14 and records became final in Java 16.

sections.title: Separate fixed choices from data values
Give names and components a type
Generated behavior still needs design choices
Store meanings rather than declaration positions
Do not confuse compact syntax with stronger guarantees
Choose the declaration that matches the meaning

examples.title: Enum values with behaviour
examples.explanationHtml: Each enum constant is one named instance. Its stored rate determines the fee; values follows declaration order.

examples.title: An exhaustive enum switch expression
examples.explanationHtml: The switch expression covers both enum constants. It selects three without fall-through.

examples.title: A validated record value
examples.explanationHtml: The compact constructor validates parameters before implicit field assignment. Generated equality compares both components.

examples.title: Copy a mutable record component
examples.explanationHtml: The constructor replaces the incoming reference with an unmodifiable copy. Later source-list changes do not affect the plan.

practice.title: Enum loan fees
practice.statementHtml: Read kind (REGULAR or SHORT) and days (0..30). Store daily rates 2 and 5 in an enum, then print the fee as an integer.
hints: Enum.valueOf uses the exact constant name.

practice.title: Record total for a bill
practice.statementHtml: Read quantity (0..100) and unitPrice (0..1000). Define a Bill record with those components and an instance total() method. Print the total in whole taka.
hints: Records may declare additional behaviour derived from their components.

practice.title: A final list reference is not a frozen list
practice.statementHtml: A record stores an ArrayList without copying. Explain why the record can appear to change.
practice.answerHtml: The component reference is final, but the list object remains mutable. Changes through the original reference or accessor change the observed contents. Use List.copyOf in the constructor; deeply mutable elements need their own copying policy.
hints: Separate the component binding from its target.

practice.title: Avoid ordinal storage
practice.statementHtml: Why should a saved loan file store REGULAR instead of LoanKind.ordinal()?
practice.answerHtml: ordinal depends on declaration position. Reordering or inserting constants changes the numbers. Store a stable explicit code or a documented name and define how unknown future values are handled.
hints: Imagine adding a constant before the existing ones.

quiz.prompt: How do enum-specific daily rates affect three-day fees?
quiz.explanation: The loop follows declaration order and multiplies each stored rate by three.

quiz.prompt: Which hour value does the LAB enum branch return?
quiz.explanation: The exhaustive switch expression yields the LAB branch value.

quiz.prompt: Are two separately constructed records with equal components equal?
quiz.explanation: The accessors return component values and generated equals compares their values.

options: A separate subclass declaration in every case
A named instance of its enum type
quiz.explanation: Enums provide a fixed set of named typed choices.

quiz.prompt: Which accessor is generated for record Mark(int score)?
quiz.explanation: Record accessor names match their component names.

quiz.prompt: Can a record extend a user-defined class?
quiz.explanation: A record can implement interfaces, but has a fixed superclass.

quiz.prompt: What does a compact record constructor normally omit?
quiz.explanation: The compiler performs component field assignments after the compact constructor body.

quiz.prompt: Does a record guarantee deep immutability?
options: Yes, all reachable objects are frozen
Only if every accessor is public
No, mutable component objects need care
quiz.explanation: Final component references do not freeze their targets.
Records became a permanent feature in Java 16.

quiz.prompt: How does Enum.valueOf treat an unknown name?
quiz.explanation: Validate or catch at the boundary when input is not trusted.

keyPoints.en: Enums model a fixed set of named choices.
keyPoints.bn: নির্দিষ্ট কয়েকটি নামসহ অপশন বোঝাতে এনাম ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Enum constants can carry fields and behaviour.
keyPoints.bn: এনাম কনস্ট্যান্টের নিজস্ব ফিল্ড আর মেথড থাকতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: Records generate accessors and value-based Object methods.
keyPoints.bn: রেকর্ডে accessor, equals, hashCode আর toString নিজে থেকে তৈরি হয়।

keyPoints.en: Compact constructors can validate and normalize components.
keyPoints.bn: কমপ্যাক্ট কনস্ট্রাক্টরে কম্পোনেন্টের মান যাচাই বা ঠিক করে নিতে পারো।

keyPoints.en: Mutable components need a defensive-copy policy.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পোনেন্ট মিউটেবল হলে কপি করার নিয়ম ঠিক করো।

examQuestions.question: Model a fixed member category with its borrowing limit.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use enum MemberKind with STUDENT(3), STAFF(8), a private final limit field, a constructor and limit() method. Callers use typed constants instead of unrelated integers. Do not store ordinal as a durable category identifier.

examQuestions.question: Compare a record with an ordinary immutable class.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A record declares its state through components and generates accessors, equals, hashCode and toString. It is final and cannot extend a user class. An ordinary class can hide a different representation and choose identity or value equality. Both require care for mutable referenced objects.

examQuestions.question: Explain the output of equal records containing two separate arrays with equal entries.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Default record equality uses the component type’s equality. Arrays inherit identity equality, so separate arrays with equal entries normally make the records unequal. Use a value-based collection or explicit array-aware equality when that is the intended contract.
